cd /work && cat > /tmp/reads.py <<'EOF'
import ast, os
KEY="DB_URL"
reads=[]
for fn in sorted(os.listdir("modules")):
    p=os.path.join("modules",fn)
    src=open(p,encoding="utf-8").read()
    tree=ast.parse(src)
    found=False
    for n in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(n,ast.Subscript) and isinstance(n.ctx,ast.Load) \
           and isinstance(n.slice,ast.Constant) and n.slice.value==KEY:
            found=True
        if isinstance(n,ast.Call):
            f=n.func
            nm=None
            if isinstance(f,ast.Attribute):
                nm=(f.value.id+"." if isinstance(f.value,ast.Name) else "")+f.attr
            elif isinstance(f,ast.Name):
                nm=f.id
            if nm in ("os.getenv","getenv","os.environ.get","environ.get"):
                for a in n.args[:1]:
                    if isinstance(a,ast.Constant) and a.value==KEY:
                        found=True
    if found: reads.append(p)
print(len(reads))
print("\n".join(reads))
EOF
python /tmp/reads.py > /tmp/out.txt && cat /tmp/out.txt && python - <<'EOF'
lines=open("/tmp/out.txt").read().split()
n=lines[0]; files=lines[1:]
assert int(n)==len(files)==12, (n,len(files))
open("/work/answer.txt","w",encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(files)+"\n")
print("written", len(files))
EOF
echo "--- answer.txt"; cat answer.txt; wc -l answer.txt
